name: Shibushi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Shibushi city emblem in light blue, green and orange: a light blue and green stylised bird with an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Shibushi, a city in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 2006.

features.role: Shibushi city emblem — a light blue and green stylised bird with an orange disc
